title: Register an independent synthetic patient
steps: Enter unique invented identity and matching password
expected: Casey reaches their own patient dashboard.

title: Register a family caregiver into the correct workspace
expected: Caregiver is routed to Family Access with no inherited patient data.

title: Billing staff creates a patient-specific invoice
expected: Invoice drawer identifies Casey and $50 patient responsibility.

title: Patient sees invoice calculations and unpaid status
expected: Charges $80, adjustment $30, responsibility and remaining $50; unpaid.

title: Cancelling a payment confirmation leaves balance unchanged
expected: Invoice remains unpaid with no $15 payment history.

title: Partial simulated payment persists after refresh
expected: Partially Paid with $15 paid and $35 remaining.

title: Overpayment is rejected without changing the balance
expected: Visible validation rejects overpayment and balance stays $35.

title: Paying the exact remaining balance closes the invoice
expected: Invoice is Paid, remaining $0, and payment form is removed.

title: Download a genuine payment receipt PDF
expected: Receipt identifies Casey and $35; downloaded file has a PDF signature.

title: Download a complete paid statement PDF
expected: Statement preview contains the invoice number and a genuine PDF is downloaded.

title: Unpublished clinical document stays out of patient list
steps: Create private clinical letter for Casey
expected: Staff sees an unpublished document; patient cannot find it.

title: Published document becomes readable and downloadable
steps: Publish the clinical letter and confirm
expected: Patient sees correct content and a valid PDF.

title: Draft lab result is visible only to staff
steps: Create Final lab value 100 with range 80–120
expected: Staff displays private result; patient list does not expose it.

title: Publish lab and verify patient values and reference range
expected: Patient sees 100 demo-unit, reference 80–120, In range.

title: Withdrawing a lab blocks its already-open patient detail
expected: Patient sees readable unavailable message, no result value, and Back to list.

title: Republishing restores the original report URL
expected: Original result URL works again without creating a second record.

title: Fresh patient has no unconsented family access
expected: Both incoming access and outgoing sharing show empty states.

title: Family invitation requires at least one shared section
expected: Validation says choose at least one section and keeps the form open.

title: Results-only invitation stays pending before consent
expected: Pending invitation is shown without granting linked-profile access.

title: Cancelling consent leaves family access pending
expected: Invitation remains Pending and no shared profile appears.

title: Accepting consent activates only selected sections
expected: Casey becomes linked, with Test Results link but no Billing link in that card.

title: Family access cannot open an unshared billing section
steps: Navigate to Billing with Casey family-profile context
expected: Visible permission denial; invoice details are not exposed.

title: Consenting caregiver can open shared patient lab
expected: Correct family banner and 100 demo-unit result are displayed.

title: Revocation removes access from a stale family detail link
steps: Caregiver refreshes their existing lab detail
expected: Caregiver sees unavailable/permission error and cannot read result.

title: Care-team signup creates a pending application
steps: Register a Physician with organization and invented identity
expected: Applicant sees Pending application rather than staff records.

title: Pending staff cannot bypass review with a direct workspace URL
expected: Pending review remains visible and laboratory records are absent.

title: Administrator approves only the selected synthetic staff application
steps: Approve Cory with decision note and confirmation
expected: Cory application changes to Approved with verification note.

title: Approved applicant enters physician workspace without a new signup
steps: Click Check application status as Cory
expected: Staff workspace and clinical work areas appear.

title: Physician role does not gain billing or administrator privileges
steps: Try direct billing area and access reviews routes
expected: No invoice-management or access-review controls become available.

title: Mobile staff record drawer remains usable and closes with Escape
steps: Open Casey lab as approved physician at 390px viewport
expected: Drawer is on screen, page has no horizontal overflow, Escape closes it.
